reviews.title: I’m impressed actually
reviews.text: I was very very skeptical about getting this app at first (which I believe every human being is at things like this every day all day all around the world). I was listening to a podcast called “Morbid” and this app were the girls sponsor for that day and when they started explaining this app and what it does. I honestly had to stop and go back and listen to it again. Lol. Cuz one of my serious issues about getting up in the mornings was hard for be. Just because I HATED THE ALARM SOUNDS THAT CAME WITH ANYTHING. EVERRRRR!! It didn’t matter what it was. I hate being woke up by the loud freakin beeping sounds that wakes me up in a panic and anxiety high situation!! I was always late for work. BUT THIS APP smh. Freakin WORTH EVERY SINGLE DOLLAR AND ITS NOT EVEN THAT MUCH for year!! I’m so in love with this app smh I can’t even say thank you so much to the creators!! Foreal im getting to work freakin early even! My supervisor was really impressed how I’ve been coming into work and just being in a better mood!! This app is seriously the most amazing. How they use nature sounds that slowly just starts and then my brain just slowly starts to hear birds chirping or leave tussling OR my FAV is hearing the pots and pans and bacon cooking on the stove!! Always reminds me of me being a kid waking up at my Oma’s (granny) house in the morning. Lol. Thank you creators SO much!

reviews.title: Beautiful New Interface
reviews.text:
I’ve been using SleepWave exclusively for quite a few years, the new interface, features and layout improve so much an already solid app. 
But now it feels like a Tesla level experience and we’re loving it. 
It feels intuitive & effortless to use now. 
I will use and support this app for the rest of my days, it’s the perfect alarm clock and I feel like I still haven’t explored & experienced everything it has to offer. 
Thank you SW team for creating this beautiful app.

reviews.title: 130 days, great app
reviews.text: I started using this because my iPhone alarm would randomly not have any sound, and because I had never tracked my sleep before. This app is great! I'm 130 days in, and it's been great for me even though I haven't made a single purchase in-app. Just need to have your phone plugged in and facing you as you sleep. Alarm is gentle and always goes off, it says that it goes with your sleep cycle to wake you up, giving about a 15 minute timeframe before the set time. You can look back on your hours and how much time you spent in each stage if the sleep cycle, and with their recent addition of nap tracking/a timer, I'm very satisfied with it, would recommend!

My issue is that my phone has to be on my nightstand for it to track accurately and so if I want to use it for it’s useful features I have to bring my phone to bed with me every night. This is where the process has been taking a negative toll personally because I am more prone to act on thoughts and start doing stuff on my phone.  This app would be excellent if it also had the option of getting an additional device with it so I wouldn’t have to bring my phone to bed with me to use it.

reviews.title: Great app with one minor drawback.
reviews.text:
I love this app and it truly is one of the best sleep apps I have used so far. The only thing lacking in this app ( and the reason I rated this 4 out of 5 ) would be the option for vibration for the alarm. I am hard of hearing and completely deaf in one ear. I am a side sleeper and sometimes I am asleep on a side where I cannot hear the alarm. The vibration would be excellent to wake up someone like me or even someone that is a super heavy sleeper. I do hope the developers see this and I look forward to this being a new addition in an update soon.
* Edit to add that I wish there was a way for it to not be so easy to toggle AM/PM on the alarm. I have accidentally toggled PM for an alarm and not been woken up at my target time which is incredible frustrating!! I would pay for these features. The app is so good and those small details would make it 10/10. Please read this app developers. 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻

reviews.text: I used this app for years and really liked all the features. But all of a sudden, the alarm stopped working. I did nothing different than what I had been doing for years.  I tried everything to fix it. I even deleted the app and redownloaded it (which deleted all of my data from over the years 😭). I tried emailing them for help and eventually they stopped answering me. I don’t know what else to do. I truly did love the app but it just started to get unreliable and cost too much to not work. I had to move to a different app.

reviews.title: Very useful
reviews.text: My only experience is with the premium version and it is excellent. Instead of focusing only on the alarm, which is the reason that I downloaded it, they have added all kinds of things like recordings so I can hear if I’m snoring. It’s great that they provide gentle awakening sounds prior to the alarm. Also, they shuffle through different sounds on the alarms and gentle awakening, which I hope will stop me from falling into a well worn pattern of hitting snooze. There’s a place to jot down your dreams and set a goal for the next day. I can look at my sleep trends over the week, the month, or the year. I’m really finding premium to be worth it which I didn’t expect.
